pack.polytone.needs_opengl.confirm: This pack needs OpenGL %s but this device only has %s. Some of its effects won't show. Load it anyway?
config.polytone.lenient_loading.tooltip: Attempts loading packs with errors. Not guaranteed to work. Do NOT enable this if you are a pack creator.
config.polytone.legacy_parsing.tooltip: Tries to translate formats from other mods to be parsed as Polytone files. Relevant for custom colors and colormaps.
config.polytone.auto_particle_rate_limit: Rate limits each particle emitter from polytone packs. Each will be relate limited after 2 particles every tick steady state or after 400 particles burst every 5 seconds.
config.polytone.particles_throttle.toolt: Scales down the amount of custom spawned particles. Decrease to artificially lowers their spawn chance. This is a last resort option to increase performance in unoptimized packs and should normally not be used.
config.polytone.custom_particles_async.t: Spreads Custom Particle ticking across multiple threads to reduce main-thread lag when using many custom particles.
config.polytone.particle_hitbox_debug.to: Renders particle hitboxes when F3+G (chunk borders) is enabled
config.polytone.show_config_button.toolt: Shows the Polytone config button on the resource pack selection screen.
config.polytone.sky_depth_write.tooltip: Lets the sky shader write to the depth buffer. Experimental. Needed in some packs.
config.polytone.dev_polytone_extra.toolt: Extra polytone-namespace row for grouping tests.
config.test_pack_alpha.dev_alpha_throttl: Dev-only number slider with pack and section presets.
config.test_pack_alpha.dev_wide_note.too: Wide full-width row inside a section.
config.polytone.post_chains_after_hand.t: Runs depth-reading post shaders (like godrays) after first person hands.
config.polytone.attribute_time_smoothing: How long in seconds, time blended environment attributes take to fade to a new value.
config.polytone.colored_lights_backend.t: How resource pack colored lights are drawn. Built-in tints vanilla block light on blocks, entities and particles. Hybrid does the same and lets Veil add moving lights for entities, items and particles. Veil uses the Veil mod's lights for everything. Off keeps vanilla light.
config.polytone.smooth_entity_lighting.t: Blends the light around entities instead of reading a single block, so they don't jump in brightness when moving between light levels.
config.polytone.voxel_volume_width.toolt: Width in blocks of the voxel volume box around the camera, used by colored block light and shader packs that read it. Doubling it takes 4 times the VRAM. 128 by 128 takes about 13 MB.
config.polytone.voxel_volume_height.tool: Height in blocks of the voxel volume box. Lowering it is the cheap way to afford a wider range, since light rarely matters far above or below you.
config.polytone.far_light_range.tooltip: Width in blocks of a low detail light volume past the light range. It only tints vanilla block light there, so colors reach further for very little cost. 0 turns it off.
config.polytone.light_spread_steps.toolt: How many blocks per frame light travels inside the voxel volume. Higher reacts faster to placed and broken lights but costs more GPU time.
